name: Rakata Prime
description: Rakata Prime, also known as Rakata and Lehon, was the homeworld of the long-extinct Rakata species, who were rumored to be the first to develop hyperspace travel, and was one of the few navigable worlds located in the Unknown Regions. The planet was orbited by a refueling station. At some point, the Resistance pilot Venisa Doza visited Lehon along with her astromech droid, Torch. The Zabrak pirate Tryki was also once arrested for attempting to board a First Order cruiser near Rakata Prime.
